description.html: Which Electric Bike Is Right For You? In the past 5 years, electric bikes as a means of transportation have taken off. The popularity of these electric rideables caught the attention of GOTRAX and we have been developing and perfecting our own electric bikes that thousands of riders currently enjoy. If you’re looking for your own electric bike, and you’re not sure what you need to look out for, we have detailed the most important components you need to consider. CATEGORIES All Terrain City Foldable Compact Foldable F1 PRICE: $799.99 Motor: 350W Tires: 20" Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 65.3" x 26.7" x 48.4" Battery: Lithium-ion 48V 7.8aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 25 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 44 lbs Top Speed: 20 MPH Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Display Suspension: N/A Compact EBE1 PRICE: $799.99 Motor: 350W Tires: 16" Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 33.9" x 15" x 25.6" Battery: Lithium-ion 36V 7.5aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 27.9 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 44 lbs Top Speed: 15.5 Mph Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Display Suspension: Rear Wheel Endura PRICE: $999.99 Motor: 250W Tires: 26" Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 69.3" x 24" x 46.9" Battery: Lithium-ion 36V 7.5aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 27.9 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 53.9 lbs Top Speed: 15.5 Mph Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Display Suspension: Front Wheel Compact electric bikes are ultra commuter friendly, and are recommended for riders who are looking to ride shorter distances, sub 10 miles. Cost Effective: The compact electric bikes from GOTRAX are among our most affordable. Riders looking to for an e-bike on a lower budget will love what we have to offer. Impaired Mobility: The compact models are also great for riders with imparied mobility. The step through design makes these bikes easy to get in and out of. Our compact models also feature cruise control, an easy to read digital display screen, pedal assist, hand throttle brakes, comfortable seats, and rear suspension. Commuting and Errands Emerge PRICE: $999.99 Motor: 350W Tires: 26" Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 68.5" x 25.6" x 42.9" Battery: Lithium-ion 36V 7.5aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 26 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 47.7 lbs Top Speed: 20 Mph Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Display Suspension: Front Wheel Alpha XL PRICE: $1,099.99 Motor: 350W Tires: 29" Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 72.8" x 25.6" x 44.9" Battery: Lithium-ion 36V 7.5aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 26 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 50.8 lbs Top Speed: 20 Mph Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Display Suspension: Front Wheel EBE2 PRICE: $1,199.99 Motor: 350W Tires: 26" Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 68.1" x 24.8" x 42.1" Battery: Lithium-ion 36V 12.5aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 50 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 45.6 lbs Top Speed: 20 Mph Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Digital Display Suspension: Front Wheel Commuter-friendly electric bikes are our specialty. GOTRAX has created e-bike models for riders looking to travel short, moderate and long distances. There are a handful of features to consider when shopping for a commuter bike. Commute Distance: How far you’re looking to ride will be one of the most important elements you need to consider. Our models can go anywhere from 15 to 50 miles per charge. If you plan to ride your e-bike for the entirety of your commute, you should look into our models that support long distances. Shorter commutes, or commutes that also include other forms of public transportation will do well with our e-bikes that manage well on shorter distances. Battery Size: The size of the battery will correspond to greater travel distances. As mentioned, if you are planning to use your e-bike on longer commutes, consider a model with a larger battery capacity. 36 Volts is a great battery size that will support longer distances. Tire Size: The tires of your electric bike can make or break your experience. The standard tire size for our models is 26”. Our tires are shock absorbent and wear resistant so that you can enjoy riding without issue. Taller riders will enjoy our 29” tires. Commute-Specific Features: Every commuter is different, and that is why all of our models are different. We offer a range of features that are specific to what any commuter may need. These features include hand throttle brakes, pedal assist, high speed capacity, step through designs, fatigue and fracture resistant frames, digital display technology and headlights. Off Road/Mountain Bikes EBE4 PRICE: $1,099.99 Motor: 350W Tires: 20" Fat Tire Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 68.1" x 22.8" x 47.2" Battery: Lithium-ion 48V 10aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 50 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 60 lbs Top Speed: 20 Mph Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Digital Display Suspension: Front Wheel Traveler PRICE: $1,199.99 Motor: 500W Tires: 29" Air-Filled Tires Dimensions: 72.8" x 25.6" x 44.9" Battery: Lithium-ion 48V 10aH Waterproof Rating: IPX4 Frame Material: Aluminum alloy A6061 Range: 31 miles Brakes: Front and Rear Brake Disc Weight: 49.3 lbs Top Speed: 20 Mph Lights: Front LED Headlight Drive: Rear Wheel Drive Weight Limit: 265lbs Display: LED Digital Display Suspension: Front Wheel For our outdoor-loving, off road seeking riders, GOTRAX has developed electric bikes that are built to withstand your needs. When looking for an off road/mountain e-bike, we have some features you recommend you consider. Top Speeds and Large Motors: Our off roading electric bikes offer uniquely fast speeds, reaching up to 20mph. Adventure seekers can enjoy that these models are built with motors upwards of 500 Watts, allowing these models to go fast and ride strong on whatever terrain you face. Suspension: Suspension is everything when it comes to off roading. If you are considering taking your e-bike off of city streets, look into models with stronger suspension. Fat Tires: Fat tire e-bikes are great for off-roading. The size of these tires allow for a stable ride on rocky roads and paths. Frames on these tires are a force to be reckoned with.

Which Electric Scooter Is Right for Your Child? Since joining the market in 2017, GOTRAX has continuously sought out ways to offer commuters bold, beautiful and eco-friendly electric rideables that expand the possibilities for personal transportation. There are a few categories to consider when choosing an electric scooter CATEGORIES Scout GKS Series Vibe Scout PRICE: $119.99 Range: 3 Miles Motor: 80W Weight: 9.7lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 10.8V 2.6aH Top Speed: 6 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 25.2" x 14.6" x 33.8" LED Lights: In Deckboard Max Rider Weight: 110 Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Black, Blue, Green, Pink Single Button Activation - The Scout is the smallest e-scooter we have ever made. It is meant as the first step for kids ages 6+ into the fun and exciting world of electric scooters. The single button is easy to activate and makes riding simple for kids. LED Deckboard - Your kids face isn't the only thing that will light up when they right this scooter. The LED's in the deckboard will match with whichever color you choose for your scooter. Small Motor + Low Speeds - We don't expect your child to be commuting with this e-scooter. We kept the motor small and the speed low so your child can get comfortable riding a scooter with a motor in it. Solid Rubber Tires - The GKS line-up is built with sold-rubber tires so don't worry about flats and having to swap tires and tubes. We know kids can be a little rough with toys they can ride around so make it easy on yourself by getting an electric LED Lightning Features - The GKS Lumios and GKS Plus come with a LED front wheel and LED Strips on the tiller, respectively. If your child wants to stand out with their ride these kids electric scooters are great choices. Vibe PRICE: $279.99 Range: 7 Miles Motor: 200W Weight: 20.9lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 36V 4.0aH Top Speed: 12 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 43.3" x 17.1" x 14.6" LED Lights: No Max Rider Weight: 220lbs Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Blue, Red, Gray, Pink Digital Display - Get accurate battery levels and speedometer readings with this digital display built-in to the handlebars of this electric scooter for teens. LED Front Light - For evening rides, brighten the way ahead with this LED headlight. The light can be activated and turned off through the power button on the handlebars while the scooter is powered up. Foldable - The Vibe can be folded in half and carried thanks to our hook-n-latch system. We don't want the scooter swinging around and hitting anyone in the ankles. It also significantly reduces the amount of space this scooter takes up when not in use.

media.alt_text: Gotrax T7 Kids Electric Scooter - GOTRAX

description.html: Which Electric Scooter Is Right for Your Child? Since joining the market in 2017, GOTRAX has continuously sought out ways to offer commuters bold, beautiful and eco-friendly electric rideables that expand the possibilities for personal transportation. There are a few categories to consider when choosing an electric scooter CATEGORIES Scout GKS Series Vibe Scout PRICE: $119.99 Range: 3 Miles Motor: 80W Weight: 9.7lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 10.8V 2.6aH Top Speed: 6 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 25.2" x 14.6" x 33.8" LED Lights: In Deckboard Max Rider Weight: 110 Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Black, Blue, Green, Pink Single Button Activation - The Scout is the smallest e-scooter we have ever made. It is meant as the first step for kids ages 6+ into the fun and exciting world of electric scooters. The single button is easy to activate and makes riding simple for kids. LED Deckboard - Your kids face isn't the only thing that will light up when they right this scooter. The LED's in the deckboard will match with whichever color you choose for your scooter. Small Motor + Low Speeds - We don't expect your child to be commuting with this e-scooter. We kept the motor small and the speed low so your child can get comfortable riding a scooter with a motor in it. GKS Series GKS PRICE: $149.99 Range: 6.2 Miles Motor: 150W Weight: 17.8lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 25.2V 2.0aH Top Speed: 7 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 25.2" x 14.6" x 33.8" LED Lights: No Max Rider Weight: 121 Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Black, Blue, Green, Pink GKS Lumios PRICE: $199.99 Range: 5 Miles Motor: 150W Weight: 14.8lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 25.2V 2.6aH Top Speed: 7.5 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 32.6" x 15.5" x 36.9" LED Lights: In Front Wheel Max Rider Weight: 154 Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Green, Gray, Blue, Pink GKS Pro PRICE: $169.99 Range: 5 Miles Motor: 150W Weight: 18.7lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 24V 4.0aH Top Speed: 9 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 39.3" x 16.9" x 39.3" LED Lights: No Max Rider Weight: 176lbs Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Blue, Gray, Pink, Teal GKS Plus PRICE: $229.99SALES PRICE: $199.99 Range: 7 Miles Motor: 150W Weight: 20.9lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 25.2V 4.0aH Top Speed: 7.5 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 32" x 15.2" x 34.2" LED Lights: On Tiller and Deckboard Max Rider Weight: 176lbs Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Blue, Red, Gray, Pink Two Button Activation - The GKS Series has several stand out features primarily the Two Button Motor Activation that makes riding easy and smooth for children as young as 6. Solid Rubber Tires - The GKS line-up is built with sold-rubber tires so don't worry about flats and having to swap tires and tubes. We know kids can be a little rough with toys they can ride around so make it easy on yourself by getting an electric LED Lightning Features - The GKS Lumios and GKS Plus come with a LED front wheel and LED Strips on the tiller, respectively. If your child wants to stand out with their ride these kids electric scooters are great choices. Vibe PRICE: $279.99 Range: 7 Miles Motor: 200W Weight: 20.9lbs Battery: Lithium Ion 36V 4.0aH Top Speed: 12 mph Warranty: 90 Days Charge Time: 4 hours Dimensions: 43.3" x 17.1" x 14.6" LED Lights: No Max Rider Weight: 220lbs Tires: Solid Rubber Colors: Blue, Red, Gray, Pink Digital Display - Get accurate battery levels and speedometer readings with this digital display built-in to the handlebars of this electric scooter for teens. LED Front Light - For evening rides, brighten the way ahead with this LED headlight. The light can be activated and turned off through the power button on the handlebars while the scooter is powered up. Foldable - The Vibe can be folded in half and carried thanks to our hook-n-latch system. We don't want the scooter swinging around and hitting anyone in the ankles. It also significantly reduces the amount of space this scooter takes up when not in use.
